name: Studio II: Industrial Design
description:
Introduction to sheet metal and manufacturing processes - through videos, visits and component study.
Study of sheet metal details - understanding K factor, laser cutting considerations, bending sequence, etc.
Formal detailing while iteratively planning component break-up, assembly techniques for servicing and disassembly for recycling. 
Internal component mounting, cable routing, heat dissipation and movement of components.
Strengthening and stiffening components through geometry, use of stiffeners, cleats, etc.
Modelling, preparing drawings and files for processing and subsequent assembly.
Exercises in Orthographic drawing - representing modelled components through technical drawings, including sections, exploded views, component and assembly drawings.
